items.title: ObservabilityCON on the Road: New sessions coming to you in 2027
items.summary: If you couldn't make it to San Francisco for ObservabilityCON 2026, don’t worry. We’re bringing the highlights of ObservabilityCON to five more international destinations in 2027. It’s your chance to take a deeper dive into new Grafana Cloud capabilities designed to reshape cloud economics, bring context together to expand visibility into the end-user experience, and help you move toward autonomous operations.Registration is open for ObservabilityCON on the Road for:Amsterdam on Feb. 9, 2027Frankfurt on Feb. 23, 2027Paris on March 4, 2027Sydney on March 11, 2027Dallas on March 23, 2027Register now at our early bird rate while seats last. Capacity is limited, and early bird tickets will go fast, so reserve your spot today.What to expect at ObservabilityCON on the RoadWith ObservabilityCON on the Road, everything the community loves most about ObservabilityCON—technical deep dives, live demos, and Grafana Labs experts who'll take your toughest questions—fits into one day in a city near you.More specifically, it's a great opportunity to:Watch Grafana Assistant take on more of the work of deploying, running, and fixing your software, from opening an investigation the moment an alert fires to validating a fix's impact in production.Open the black box on your AI agents with Grafana Cloud Agent Observability, which brings agent sessions in as a fifth telemetry signal, correlated with your metrics, logs, traces, and profiles.Get ahead of rising data volumes and costs. Hear how Mimir, the open source database that powers Grafana Cloud Metrics, is raising the ceiling on ingestion and query speed. And see how Adaptive Telemetry helps cut low-value data while retaining the insights you actually need.Close the gap between what you monitor and what your users experience, with a live digital experience monitoring demo that starts with a conversion drop and works back to the root cause.Get answers from Grafana Labs experts, test drive our latest features at demo booths, and trade notes with peers throughout the day and at the closing reception.For more details, please check out the full ObservabilityCON on the Road agenda for your city.We look forward to seeing you there!
